history.summary: Bhuteshwar is mapped here to the 'Bhuthnatheswar Mahadev Temple' at Bhootmugali (Bhutmugli), Nilanga taluka, Latur district — 'Bhuteshwar' and 'Bhuthnatheswar' are variant spellings of the same name ('lord of bhutas', an epithet of Shiva). The village account describes Bhutmugli's Mahadev temple as the oldest Sadashiv Hemadpanti temple in the village centre, alongside Hanuman and Ambamata temples, with Mahadev baras and harinam saptah as the village's biggest festivals. IDENTITY FLAG (provisional): no web source spells this shrine 'Bhuteshwar'; the mapping rests on phonetic equivalence plus the Justdial listing 'Bhuthnatheswar Mahadev Temple' at Bhootmugali, Latur (4.1/5, 29 ratings). CSV CORRECTION: the actual town is Bhutmugli (Bhootmugali), Nilanga taluka, Latur district — approx. 47 km southeast of Latur city; the CSV town 'Latur' is the district, not the town.

name: Shri Bhuteshwar Temple
town_description: Bhutmugli (Bhootmugali) is a village in Nilanga taluka of Latur district, Maharashtra, with a population of about 8,000. It is known locally for its ancient Hemadpanti Mahadev (Sadashiv) temple, Hanuman temple and Ambamata temple at the village centre; Hinduism is the predominant religion.
